    }

        seq[cur_len].push_back(diff_mod(idx, cur_val));
        idx++;
        if (cur_len < 6) {
            cur_len++;
            cur_val *= 10;
        } else {
            cur_val++;
            while (cur_val % 10 == 0) cur_val /= 10, cur_len--;

        for (int x : seq[i]) {

        }
    }

    int edge = 1, digits = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAX_N; ++i) {

            digits++;

    }

    ll cur = start_val / 100 + 1;
